name: Nigerian Fried Cheese Curds (Wara)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Strain the milk into a large pot.
Bring the milk to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Reduce the heat, and add lime juice. Do not stir. The curds should separate from the whey.
Pack the curds in a colander, and allow excess water to drain out.
Cut curds into desired shapes, and deep fry in hot oil.

culture.text: Wara refers to Nigerian cheese curds or tofu, the former being made from cow milk and the latter from soy milk. It is sometimes eaten as a snack by travelers, who can always get it as a staple product. The recipe below is for fried cow milk wara.
